description: Elements of SPTR_Type define a mapping between object type (SPT_Type)
One object type can be spooled (written) using multiple spooling rules.
One object type will be read using one (the default) spooling rule.
One spooling rule can be referenced by multiple object types.

attributes.name: is_default
description: Defines whether the referenced rule is the default rule
for reading the defined object type.

attributes.name: rule
description: Pointer/reference to the rule to be used with the defined object type.
